documents.title: Approval For Raising Of Funds For An Aggregate Amount Of Up To And Not Exceeding ? 1,800 Crores Through One Or More Public Or Private Offering Including A Qualified Institutions Placement ('QIP') Of Equity Shares Or Other Eligible Securities To Eligible Investors.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,391 crores for Q2 FY27, up 61% year-on-year, with a gross margin of 9.6%. Reported PAT for Q2 FY27 reached INR 129 crores after an exceptional charge of INR 7.35 crores related to a fraud incident at its subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra. Export revenues reached INR 435 crores in Q2 FY27, contributing to H1 FY27 exports of INR 811 crores. The company highlighted that Advance Gold accounted for 16% of Q2 FY27 business, helping moderate working capital intensity. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited presented its Q2 & H1 FY27 financial and operational results, delivering revenue from operations of ₹4,403.5 crore in H1 FY27.

guidance.claim: The company previously guided for INR 18,000 crores in revenue, INR 945 crores in PAT, 20% to 25% OCF conversion, and a net debt-free status by 2030.
guidance.quote: We had earlier guided for INR18,000 crores revenue by FY2030, INR945 crores of PAT, 20% to 25% of PAT converted into operating cash flow, and a net debt-free balance sheet by 2030.

guidance.claim: The company has historically guided for PAT margins of 5% to 5.25%.
guidance.quote: We have in the past guided for 5% to 5.25% of PAT margins.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold previously guided for ₹3,000 crore revenue, approximately 3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28.
guidance.quote: Following the preferential allotment from marquee investors in FY24, we guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28 (vs FY24 revenue of ₹1,745 Cr).

guidance.claim: Sky Gold's current FY27 revenue target is INR 8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: The company aspires to reach revenue of INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold will review and revise its guidance post-Diwali.
guidance.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold plans to achieve an operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20% and an overall PAT margin close to 5%.
guidance.quote: But our plan is that, overall, we are now targeting to have operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%, that we have also provided in our IP as well. And our overall PAT margin will be close to 5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Sky Gold achieved export revenues of INR 435 crores in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q2 FY27, we have reached exports of INR435 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer demand is shifting across karatage categories from 22-karat to 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat jewelry.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: Uncut diamond jewelry is seeing strong consumer demand and yields high margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Uncut diamonds, uncut diamond jewelry is in strong demand and carries high margins.

demand_outlook.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry rose to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shifts in customer preference.
demand_outlook.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall volumes grew by 7% to 9% during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: But overall, I can say that we have grown by 7% to 9% in the volumes in this quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects 75% of the market to be organized by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: So as per exports, we are expecting by 2030, 75% market will be organized and 25% will be unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold established its international office in Dubai during Q2 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q2 FY26, we opened our international office in Dubai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commenced operations of its Dubai international office in September 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: In September 2025, we started operations of our international office in Dubai, led by Mr. Hiralal, who brings 30 plus years of experience in Dubai and GCC.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold is conducting due diligence with a potential buyer for land monetization.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we were very close to purchase of this land ourselves last month, but there was buyer who has shown a strong interest and the process is at advanced stage of due diligence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's manufacturing footprint has expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold opened a Dubai office to support global growth.
Existing capacity is expected to be sufficient until 2028, with future expansion following a leased asset-light model.
capex_expansion.quote: And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028. And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capacity expansion post-2028 will involve capex of approximately INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Setting up a new facility to expand capacity from 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons will take 120 days.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it will take 120 days. We made this facility in 90 days where we are here now, and it will take 120 days to develop the factory to go to 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons and 100% it will take around INR80 crores to INR100 crores of capex when we will be at a PAT of, I think, INR600 crores, whatever the number going to come -and will approximately 15% or 20% of the PAT.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 133 basis points year-on-year to 9.6% in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 189.8 crores with an EBITDA margin of 7.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin, up 90%.

margins_costs.claim: Advance gold accounted for 16% of Q2 FY27 revenue, exceeding the FY27 target of 15%.
margins_costs.quote: First, advance gold was 16% of our business in Q2 '27, ahead of our '27 target of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Interest cost for H1 FY27 stood at 0.89% of sales, down from 0.96% in H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our H1 interest cost was 0.89% of sales, against 0.96% of H1 last year, and this is structural.

margins_costs.claim: An increase in the share of value-added business served as the main driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin improved by 27 basis points quarter-on-quarter to 9.3% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA reached INR 157 crores with a margin of 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins for 22 KT gold products stand between 6% and 6.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Finally, if we look at 22 KT gross margins, it comes to close to 6% to 6.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Strict back-to-back hedging policies protect company margins from gold price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: At that time, I had also emphasized that our profitability is not dependent on movements in gold prices because we follow strict back-to-back hedging policy.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains gross margin guidance in the range of 8.5% to 9%.
margins_costs.quote: The guidance of 8.5% to 9% gross margin we are giving, because, in the journey of business, you can see if 22 karat is somebody is taking volume, we have to pass on some 0.25% to 0.5% discount also to the customers.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold operates 40 3D printing machines with paper casting.
orders_capacity.quote: We adopted 3D printing with paper casting as early as 2020, and now run 40 such machines.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly manufacturing volume for Shri Rishabh Gold expanded from 20-25 kg to 150 kg.
orders_capacity.quote: Their monthly volumes have grown from about 20 kg to 25 kg to 150 kg.

orders_capacity.claim: A new client in the United Kingdom initiated orders with a 30 kg volume.
orders_capacity.quote: One new client started with an initial order of 30 kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced metal volume accounts for nearly 16% of total volumes without requiring company capital.
orders_capacity.quote: Nearly 16% of our volume comes from advanced metal, which employs no capital of ours.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold is operating at approximately 60% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total production capacity stands at 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold has built a prospective order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores across U.K. and European markets.
orders_capacity.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt decreased to INR 531 crores at the end of September 2026 compared to INR 550 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt was INR531 crores at September end, and versus INR550 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow for H1 FY27 turned positive at INR 136 crores compared to an outflow of INR 101 crores in H1 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Most importantly, we generated INR136 crores of operating cash flow in H1, against an outflow of INR101 crores in H1 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Sky Gold raised INR 270 crores through a Qualified Institutions Placement in October 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: In October 2024, we completed a QIP of INR270 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting FY27, taking payouts exclusively through dividends from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Sky Gold closed Q1 FY27 with a net working capital cycle of approximately 60 days.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result, we are closing this quarter at approximately 60 days of our net working capital cycle.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt at the end of the quarter stood at INR 540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated positive operating cash flow of around INR 30 crores in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Sky Gold prioritizes debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening over dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening.

capital_allocation.claim: Sky Gold aims to become net debt-free by 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: By 2030, our aspiration is to build a company that is net debt-free, operations with a highly efficient balance sheet, maintains industry-leading working capital metrics and consistently converts a significant portion of its earnings into sustainable operating cash flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recorded an exceptional charge of INR 7.35 crores in Q2 FY27 due to a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Out of INR 10.70 crores involved in the fraud incident, INR 3.35 crores was recovered and the remaining balance was fully provided for in Q2 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of the INR10.70 crores involved, INR3.35 crores has been recovered, and the balance is fully provided this quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Completion timeline for the proposed land sale was extended beyond August 2026.
An unauthorized incident involved INR 10.7 crores, for which legal proceedings were initiated.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has recovered INR 3.5 crores of the involved funds through legal proceedings.
risks_headwinds.quote: We have acted promptly, we have initiated the legal proceedings and have also got a favorable order as well. And close to INR3.5 crores has already come back.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will purchase the land if no final buyer commitment is received within 20 to 30 days.
management_commitments.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will draw a salary only when the business generates operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management will revisit financial targets and present updated guidance after closing the fundraise mandate.
management_commitments.quote: once this mandate is closed and considering our business is a turn-based business that we have highlighted in our speech, we will again revisit our numbers.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will stop drawing salaries starting from FY27 and receive payouts solely through operating cash flow dividends.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Completion of the land sale transaction has been extended past August 2026.
Sky Gold targets achieving INR 8,100 crores in revenue in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will adopt a zero-salary compensation model beginning FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold aims to reduce its working capital cycle to 52 days by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: And in terms of strategy, we are looking at reducing or improving on the working capital days by 2 days year- on-year, with an overall target to reach 52 days by 2030 in the Sky Gold Vision 2030 that we are looking at.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
